children: , through an offset agreement with armasuisse, Switzerland’s Federal Office for Defence Procurement, have
a new quantum innovation hub at ETH Zurich.

The hub is expected to host Switzerland’s first IBM Quantum System Two at the Swiss National Supercomputing Center in Lugano, expanding the country’s quantum-computing research capabilities and collaboration between academia, industry, and the defense sector.
The IBM Quantum System Two will be powered by an IBM Quantum Nighthawk, the company's most advanced processor.
ETH Zurich will provide expertise, resources, and technologies for Swiss industries, startups, and academia, including access to the quantum computer.
Its delivery is expected to catalyze the development of new algorithms, technical breakthroughs, and industrial use cases.

title: IBM, Lockheed Martin establish quantum innovation hub in Switzerland
